definitions.explanation: The formal gesture of raising the hand to the forehead, performed by military personnel, police officers, and similar uniformed personnel as a sign of respect.
A formal, respectful greeting or bow. Used in ceremonial or very formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{敬礼|けいれい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上官|じょうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敬礼|けいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police officer saluted the superior officer.

examples.english: They offered a respectful greeting to the guests of honor.

examples.english: Everyone stood up and paid their respects at the ceremony.

notes:
Composed of {敬|けい} (respect) + ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ (etiquette, bow). Most commonly associated with the military salute gesture, but the word originally and more broadly refers to any formal expression of respect.

USAGE:
Used as a noun ({敬礼|けいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or as a suru verb ({敬礼|けいれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). In school contexts, students may hear {起立|きりつ}、⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ (Stand, bow) rather than {敬礼|けいれい}, though some schools use {敬礼|けいれい} as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敬礼|けいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to salute, to pay respects
- ⟦{挙手|きょしゅ}→挙手：16852_kyoshu⟧{敬礼|けいれい} — hand salute (the standard military salute)
- {最敬礼|さいけいれい} — the deepest bow (45 degrees)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ — bow; the everyday word for a bow or greeting
- ⟦{会釈|えしゃく}→会釈：15858_eshaku⟧ — a light, casual bow of acknowledgment
- ⟦お{辞儀|じぎ}→お辞儀：00330_ojigi⟧ — a bow; the most common general term for bowing
